# Tailwinds — Airline Management Game

> Tailwinds is a free, browser-based airline management and strategy game. No download, no sign-up: build an airline from a $10M startup into a global carrier across 2,000+ real airports with 207 real aircraft types. Single-player against AI competitors; progress saves in your browser (optional cloud saves for supporters). Its multiplayer sibling, Headwinds (https://www.headwindsairlinegame.com), runs persistent shared worlds where every rival is a real player.

Tailwinds is free to play at https://www.tailwindsairlinegame.com — the game itself runs client-side in the browser (desktop and mobile).

## Start here

- [How to Play](https://www.tailwindsairlinegame.com/how-to-play.html): the basics — first aircraft, first routes, reading your weekly results
- [FAQ](https://www.tailwindsairlinegame.com/faq.html): is it free (yes), accounts (none needed), saving, offline play
- [About](https://www.tailwindsairlinegame.com/about.html): what the game simulates and how it was made

- [Strategy Guide](https://www.tailwindsairlinegame.com/strategy.html): openings, growth, and late-game play

- [Hub Strategy](https://www.tailwindsairlinegame.com/hub-strategy.html): choosing a hub, hub tiers and connecting traffic
- [Fleet Planning](https://www.tailwindsairlinegame.com/fleet-planning.html): matching aircraft to routes
- [Aircraft Guide](https://www.tailwindsairlinegame.com/aircraft.html): stats for all 207 aircraft, by class
- [Competition & Alliances](https://www.tailwindsairlinegame.com/competition-and-alliances.html): how AI rivals behave, fare wars, alliances and buying rivals out
- [Fuel Prices & Hedging](https://www.tailwindsairlinegame.com/fuel-hedging.html): fuel price swings and when to hedge
- [On-Time Performance](https://www.tailwindsairlinegame.com/on-time-performance.html): delays, compensation and what drives punctuality
- [Route Case Study](https://www.tailwindsairlinegame.com/route-case-study.html): one 737 route worked through with real in-game numbers
- [Beginner Mistakes](https://www.tailwindsairlinegame.com/beginner-mistakes.html): common early-game errors
- [Glossary](https://www.tailwindsairlinegame.com/glossary.html): airline and game terms
